source_note: Seed data compiled from public CDL/competitive coverage. Refresh periodically — meta shifts each season. The active map pool lives in cdl-ruleset.json (Settings -> Game Rules) — it is the single source of truth, so it is intentionally not duplicated here.

sniper: Hawker HX — favored for long lanes and power positions

general_pro_principles: Hardpoint: rotation discipline and 'money hill' control matter more than raw kills — teams that trade hill control efficiently win map control over time.
Search & Destroy: round-based, timing and utility usage decide rounds more than gunskill alone — smart plant/defuse timing and info gathering are high-value.
Overload: hybrid attack/defend objective mode, rewards vertical positioning and coordinated multi-elevation pressure.
Across all modes: staying alive as primary AR/anchor matters for team spawn control — trading your life for a kill isn't always a good trade.
Flak Jacket and Fast Hands are common competitive perk picks given current grenade/utility meta.
